description: Create a Granoflow milestone with common structured fields. When dueAt is omitted, the first project milestone defaults to today and each later milestone defaults to at least one local calendar day after the latest project deadline. Defaults to dry-run.

dryRun.description: When true, previews the request without writing.

dueAt.description: Explicit deadline. When omitted, uses today at 23:59:59.000 for the first project milestone, then one local calendar day after the latest valid project deadline.

name: granoflow_milestone_create
